sections.section_title: Procedure for Seeking Access to Biological Resources and Associated Knowledge
sections.content: Rule 14 mandates submission of Form I to the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) for non-Indian entities or Indian entities with foreign shareholding seeking access to biological resources or traditional knowledge for research or commercial utilization.

sections.section_title: Procedure for Seeking Prior Approval for Applying for Intellectual Property Rights
sections.content: Rule 18 requires filing Form III to the NBA prior to applying for any intellectual property right inside or outside India based on biological resources obtained from India. Benefit-sharing fee is computed based on purchase price or gross ex-factory sales.

sections.section_title: Transfer of Accessed Biological Resource or Knowledge to Third Party
sections.content: Form IV approval from the NBA is mandatory before transferring accessed Indian biological resources or traditional knowledge to any third-party recipient.
